'''Jellies''' are monsters only found in the [[Soul Wars]] minigame. They are one of the two monsters that can be killed for [[soul fragment]]s.

Despite their listed stats, currently they only attack with melee and can only deal a max of 1 damage, making them very easy to tank for long periods to obtain [[thaler]].
